prompts.fixBlocked: Plan: {plan}. The integrator blocked branch {branch} (tip {tip}). Fix exactly what the queue row says ({queueFile}, row of {branch}): {status} Work in the worktree {cwd} on that branch, run {compileCheck} until exit 0 and the check scripts of the changed files, push normally and write a new ready row with the new tip. Follow all rules in section 1 of ORCHESTRATOR.md, update the plan's state file, end when the fix is finished.
prompts.fixBlockedNoPlan: The integrator blocked branch {branch} (tip {tip}) and the queue row has no plan. The row says: {status} The main checkout ({cwd}) stays on {integrationBranch} and is never edited: create your own worktree for that branch next to it ({newWorktree}), fix exactly what the row says, run {compileCheck} until exit 0 and the check scripts of the changed files, push normally and write a new ready row with the new tip into {queueFile}. Follow all rules in section 1 of ORCHESTRATOR.md, end when the fix is finished.
prompts.answeredQuestion: Plan: {plan}, item {item} (question {qid}). {owner} answered: {answer} Implement exactly this answer in the worktree {cwd} on the branch the plan names for this item (never invent one). Follow all rules in section 1 of ORCHESTRATOR.md, update the plan's state file, end when the item is finished.
prompts.verifyOpenWork: Plan: {plan}, package {pkg}. The independent verification {verifier} answered that requirements are open (answer: {answerPath}, details in the plan's state file). Implement exactly the open requirements it lists, nothing else, and nothing the plan leaves to {owner}. Work in {cwd} (the main checkout is never edited: use your own worktree on a sub-branch of the plan's feature branch when code changes). Follow all rules in section 1 of ORCHESTRATOR.md, update the plan's state file with evidence per requirement, end when all of them are done.
prompts.restartWork: Plan: {plan}, package {pkg}. The previous work agent {previous} never got a pane (technical failure of the window); start the package again from the plan and its state file (what is already done stays done). Work in {cwd} (the main checkout is never edited: use your own worktree on a sub-branch of the plan's feature branch when code changes). Follow all rules in section 1 of ORCHESTRATOR.md, update the plan's state file, end when the package is finished.
prompts.workInMainCheckout: The main checkout ({cwd}) stays on {integrationBranch} and is never edited. Work in your own worktree next to it ({newWorktree}) on a new sub-branch named {subBranch} of the feature branch that the plan or its state file names (create the feature branch from origin/{integrationBranch} if it does not exist, merge your sub-branch back into it locally when the package is finished).
prompts.workInWorktree: Work in the worktree {cwd} and the branch the plan names for this package (never invent them).
prompts.release: Release of the branch of plan {plan} (worktree {cwd}): merge origin/{integrationBranch} (keep both sides of every conflict), run {compileCheck} until exit 0, run the check scripts for the changed files, push normally and write the ready row into {queueName} with 'Kompiliertest: Exit 0' ({buildFlowDoc} rules 3-5). Follow all rules in section 1 of ORCHESTRATOR.md, update the plan's state file, end when the release is finished.
prompts.integrator: You are the integrator. Follow {integratorInstructions} and {buildFlowDoc}: read the ready rows of {queueFile}, merge them, one Release build, check scripts, load test, push {integrationBranch}, deploy, set the rows to integriert. Follow all rules in section 1 of ORCHESTRATOR.md.
